resolution_notes: free_tier: true — AWS Free Tier includes limited free Bedrock model invocation for eligible new accounts (select models); see AWS Free Tier / Bedrock pricing (2026). free_tier_limits: Published on pricing/Free Tier pages (model-specific free token/request allowances that change over time; not "unknown"). rate_limits: Published as per-model/region service quotas (RPM/TPM etc.) at docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/quotas.html — not "not published". base_url HTTP 0 is expected for SigV4 regional endpoints without signed requests; docs_url 200 confirms operational.
free_tier_limits: AWS Free Tier: limited free model invocation for eligible new accounts on select models (token/request caps vary by model and change over time; see AWS Free Tier and Bedrock pricing).
rate_limits: Per model and region via AWS Service Quotas (e.g. requests per minute, tokens per minute); see Bedrock quotas docs. Not a single global limit.
